g.text: SysMon - Managing User Access Sequence Diagram
Admin (Tier 1) opens the Users panel and selects Manage Access.
At any step the admin may cancel or close the panel:
no request is sent and no changes are introduced.
The same 401 and 403 answers apply to every
[Admin tier of the user is modified]
Modify admin tier of the chosen user
Modify permissions of the chosen user
